description: Ex-9 Squadron Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104A displayed as a monument at Balila on Highway 35 in Jerash governorate, coded J. Construction number 183-1085, ex USAF 56-797. The International F-104 Society places 912 here; spottingmode instead links serial 912 and the same construction number to the unmarked Starfighter on the University of Jordan campus and links nothing to Balila. This row follows the type-specific registry. Esri imagery of 1 June 2022 shows a small object at the point but is not conclusive.
